title: Fit columns to readable cell content
current_assessment: DataTableContextMenu includes Reset width and Clear sort. Header controls support manual widths and column movement. The inspected paths do not provide content-aware fit. Existing virtualization means DOM-visible cells are only part of the loaded table.

title: Find missing values and missing observations
current_assessment: fieldProfiles.ts supplies missing counts. Heatmap operates on categorical groups and metrics. The registry has no missingness diagnostic view. The October 5 Pro ledger distinguishes field missingness from absent expected observations.

title: Use one analytical result as another view’s input
current_assessment: Saved settings include named aggregates used by bars. Trace planners retain contributors. Scalar calculation inspection exists. Generic pivot/model/density outputs are not part of a source catalogue. The current provider still starts from one row array.

title: Explore nested categories and their totals
current_assessment: The registry has no hierarchy view. Pivot accepts multiple row fields; facets support one- or two-field repetition. Those are reusable entry points for a small hierarchy proof, not evidence of complete hierarchy totals and navigation.

title: Explore explicit links and edge-list flows
current_assessment: Sankey uses two to six ordered categorical stages per row and count or nonnegative sum. Its nodes and links trace contributors. The current registry has no general network view or separate edge-list flow mode.

title: Funnels, retention, and interval schedules
current_assessment: Current calendar reductions summarize source events by UTC period. Sankey summarizes categorical paths. Neither establishes cohort-entry rules, funnel event ordering, or schedule-interval semantics. The registry has no dedicated funnel, retention, or Gantt view.

title: Scientific overlays and multivariate discovery
current_assessment: Native scatter files implement regression, fit planning, paired covariance, marginal histograms, hexagonal counts, and density contours. The existing advanced-scatter plan keeps additional scientific methods below its cut line.

title: Reproduce an analysis beyond the current renderer
current_assessment: The archive includes a Pro scatter planning prototype and verification files. Active scatter and time-series planners now offer narrower real seams. SavedAnalysisStructure stores rows and settings, but no general renderer-neutral analytical result catalogue.

title: Keep explanations aligned with the selected data
current_assessment: The registry includes Markdown and Metric Card. Shared reductions and formatting can support one bounded binding. The Pro gap register distinguishes static text from a live data-bound narrative and warns that every supporting view needs clear population meaning.

title: Comprehension, featured example, integration guide, differentiation, adoption contract
current_assessment: Hero, FeaturedExample, IntegrationGuide, WhyWorkspace, and LearningLinks exist. Do not create another landing rewrite. A fresh adoption-task check belongs to trust work.

title: Task-led chart pages and shared rendering guide
current_assessment: Two chart pages and rendering docs are started. Complete-catalogue work remains in its existing initiative. New intent capture does not duplicate that ownership.

title: Advanced scatter and compact DSL
current_assessment: The October 5 audit is behind current source. Regression, polynomial/LOESS, marginals, hex bins, contours, DSL compile/export, and chart-local filters are implemented. Their existing initiatives retain ownership.

title: Multiple sources, task views, server projection
current_assessment: Multiple-source and task-view work already has owners. Server projection, remote loaded-versus-total populations, rich mutation, extra 3D variants, and gauges are not obvious comparator gaps in the current single-source workspace. Keep original reports; no new engine or server initiative is presumed.

title: End-user priorities and dedicated export scope
current_assessment: First pass: editorial styling, direct editing, scatter matrix, table usability. Time second-pass. Named comparisons low interest. Unclear seeds retain unconfirmed demand.
